user.title: Connect iCloud account
user.description: This integration creates its own Apple session, independent of the official iCloud integration. If Apple asks for verification, you choose in the next step whether the code is sent by push or SMS.

data_description.with_family: Include devices, locations and storage usage of the Family Sharing members. Off = this account only.

methode.title: Request verification code
methode.description:
Apple requires two-factor verification for {apple_id}. How should the code be delivered?

SMS number according to Apple: {nummer}

menu_options.sms: SMS to the trusted phone number

code.title: Enter verification code
code.description: The code has been requested ({weg}). Please enter the six-digit code.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to iCloud again
reauth_confirm.description: Apple ended the session for {apple_id}. Leave the password empty to keep the stored one. Next you choose how the verification code is delivered.

error.invalid_auth: Apple ID or password is wrong.

abort.security_key: The account requires a security key; this is not supported.
abort.no_2fa_method: Apple offers no usable way to deliver the verification code.
abort.send_failed: The code could not be requested. Please try again.

data_description.scan_interval: Time between two active locate requests. Every poll actively locates all devices; shorter intervals cost battery on the devices.
